# Remote Control Agent v0.1.36

This reviewed three-platform release stages **Spec #505 Computer Use for Windows** on the existing Remote Control Agent and Portal/Worker. Desktop Grant remains **disabled by default**; device pairing and version upgrades do not enable it.

- Add owner-local `rca desktop-status`, interactive `rca desktop-enable` (explicitly discloses full desktop and browser/control scope), and persistent `rca desktop-stop`. Remote callers cannot enable or resume control.
- Add bounded primary-display JPEG screenshot capture through the existing signed WSS connection, with native dimensions, origin, and observation metadata. Adaptive compression enforces a 512-KiB image limit without persistent screenshot storage or content logging.
- Preserve signed device identity, local receipts, Windows user-task lifecycle and Linux file/Shell/browser functionality. Package the reviewed Windows screenshot helper through the existing immutable installer and signature/checksum allowlists.
- Reuse the existing three-platform native candidate CI, SHA-256 release pin, manual owner upgrade and rollback; no second Worker, cloud service or deployment system.

**Not yet accepted as a complete Computer Use product:** live ChatGPT MCP image reading, per-window screenshots, keyboard/mouse mutations, macOS desktop support or locked-console continuity. No real owner's desktop screenshot was captured during release CI. Keep #509 and #505 open; tests or publishing do not replace real GUI acceptance.

Desktop Grant is a **Computer Use tool-level permission**, not an operating-system sandbox against a separately authorized Shell, and is distinct from independent Browser MCP controls. High-impact approval must not be issued by the same controlled desktop.

This release **does not** upgrade installed devices, change local desktop permissions, re-pair identities, or alter a running Windows task. Device-local upgrade must be separately verified; previous v0.1.35 remains the rollback target.
